How to Play

  • Swipe or drag across the letter wheel to connect letters into words.
  • Keyboard support: Type letters directly, press Enter to submit, Backspace to undo, or Space to shuffle.
  • 2,000 Common Words: 120 progressive levels across 3 bright lands, plus hundreds of bonus words from the 2,000-word dictionary (+5 coins each).
  • Grammar Challenges: Quick English quizzes every 4 levels earn +30 bonus coins.
